name: 35209 · Birmingham, AL
findings: ZIP 35209 (Birmingham) has 223 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35209 (Birmingham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 35209 (Birmingham) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 83 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
